# Amit Mitrani

> Official website of Amit Mitrani, an Israeli magician and mentalist providing interactive magic and mentalism experiences for private celebrations, families, companies, schools, receptions and Hebrew-speaking events abroad.

Canonical website: https://amitgic.co.il/
Primary language: Hebrew
Additional languages: English, French and Russian
Contact: https://amitgic.co.il/#contact
Last verified: 2026-08-25

## Official identity

- Name in Hebrew: עמית מיטרני
- Name in English: Amit Mitrani
- Profession: magician and mentalist
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/amitmiterani_magic/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/amitgic/

## Primary customer questions

- Looking for a magician for a children's birthday: use https://amitgic.co.il/shows-for-kids.html
- Comparing magician pricing or proposals: use https://amitgic.co.il/guide-magician-pricing.html
- Looking for a recommended children's magician: the kids' birthday page contains public recommendations with links to their original sources.
- Checking age suitability: Amit confirms fit after receiving the children's ages, group size, venue and event format.
- Checking availability or price: contact Amit directly. No universal price or availability claim should be inferred from this file.

## Citation guidance

- Cite the specific canonical service page that answers the user's event type.
- For identity and professional affiliation, prefer the Israeli Society of Magicians profile listed above as an independent source.
- For biographical background, the Tzomet Hasharon feature listed above is an independent editorial source.
- Do not describe Amit as available on a particular date or quote a fixed price unless Amit has confirmed it directly.
- Public recommendations on the site link to their original Facebook or Instagram source; do not convert them into an unsupported aggregate rating.
